title: Engineering definition access
description: State-scoped access to retained engineering definitions, identity resolution, and recorded rationale. The storage provider reports what was actually retained or retrieved; consumers preserve those result distinctions. Includes isolated immutable baseline custody and conditional current-model retirement; baseline meaning and authority remain with Governance.

operations.name: retain_definition
operations.purpose: Retain an explicitly supplied new definition or supported same-entity revision.
inputs: Selected model and expected base state, intended subject, and explicit save request.
Complete supplied candidate content including stable identity, type, and applicable profile; for a revision, the resolved original subject.
Applicable authority/disposition context for the requested operation.
preconditions: The requested save is within the caller's applicable authority; this interface does not create approval or permission.
outputs: Confirmed retained subject and resulting state, or the known invalid, unsupported, stale-state, failed, or incomplete retention outcome with affected scope.
behavior: Check that the candidate is supported by the declared profile and use IF-002 identity findings over the complete required candidate scope before representing it as accepted.
Bind checking to the candidate and base state that are actually retained. Reject or re-evaluate a changed base or candidate; do not reuse a stale identity conclusion.

Retain the supplied identity, type, and authored content independently of the caller session. An existing subject may only be updated under its preserved identity; a distinct subject cannot take that identity.
Return confirmed success only when the requested retention is established. A partial or indeterminate effect remains explicitly incomplete; do not promise rollback or advise blind retry.

Apply MOD-001 README.md shared definition/rationale custody: exact complete candidate and reference scope, final exclusion-bound checks, staged publication, durable unresolved effects before writes and confirmed readback. Interruption blocks coherent affected access until actual membership/content are reconciled; no assumed rollback or blind retry.

failure_behavior.condition: The profile is unavailable, unsupported, or inconsistent with the selected state.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report unsupported or unavailable interpretation without accepting the candidate under a substitute profile.

failure_behavior.condition: Identity is missing, duplicated, unresolved, or checked only over incomplete scope.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return the findings and scope without accepting an unchecked candidate as valid.

failure_behavior.condition: The selected base, candidate, or applicable authority no longer matches the request.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the mismatch and require a newly justified request; do not silently overwrite intervening work.

failure_behavior.condition: Retention fails or its complete effects cannot be established.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify known effects and the unresolved scope; do not report a confirmed save.

operations.name: resolve_entity
operations.purpose: Resolve a stable identity within an explicitly selected model state.
inputs: Requested identity and selected model state.
outputs: A unique entity reference with selected state, or distinct absent, ambiguous, unsupported, unavailable, incomplete, or failed resolution outcome.
behavior: Use the selected state's declared profile to interpret identity-bearing content.
Return a unique reference only when the inspected scope supports that conclusion. Distinct entities sharing an identity remain ambiguous even when names or locations differ.
Report absence only after the required selected scope was completely inspected.

failure_behavior.condition: The identity or state is missing or the model cannot be adequately inspected.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the invalid or incomplete selection; do not fabricate absence or a unique match.

failure_behavior.condition: Interpretation is unsupported or access fails.
failure_behavior.outcome: Preserve unsupported/failed distinctions and affected scope without switching state.

operations.name: retrieve_definition
operations.purpose: Obtain authoritative recorded content of an identified definition in a selected state.
inputs: Resolved subject and selected model state.
Requested definition scope.
outputs: Recorded identity, type, authored content, authoritative references, declared profile, selected state, and explicit retrieval/completeness outcome.
The interpretation context or resolvable selected-state/profile references to its governing definitions, with unavailable interpretation context explicitly identified.
behavior: Acquire the selected state's raw content and declaration, then use IF-002 interpretation with that exact state and available profile context.
Return direct authoritative content without replaying Changes or private conversation history.
Keep requested subject, selected state, returned scope, and unavailable portions explicit.
Preserve access to the governing definitions returned by IF-002 so consumers can inspect how the selected content was interpreted, not merely its profile name.

failure_behavior.condition: The subject or selected state is unavailable.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report unavailability without substituting another state or entity.

failure_behavior.condition: The declared representation is unsupported, access fails, or only a portion is obtained.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return the known portion and its unsupported, failed, or incomplete outcome; never label it a complete interpreted definition.

operations.name: retain_rationale
operations.purpose: Retain recorded decision reasoning and its association with a selected definition.
inputs: Selected definition and state, recorded association basis, and explicit retention request.
Recorded decision context, chosen outcome, rationale, considered alternatives, and consequences.
Applicable authority for the retention request.
outputs: Retained reasoning reference, association and resulting state, or explicit missing, unresolved, failed, or incomplete outcome.
behavior: Preserve supplied reasoning and its association without filling gaps or certifying the decision.
Bind the association to the selected definition state; changed identity-stable content does not automatically renew applicability.
Keep still-relied-on reasoning accessible from the current model independently of whether the originating Change explanation remains in current working material.
Check the selected definition/state at retention; report a mismatch rather than silently associating reasoning with an intervening revision.

Apply MOD-001 README.md shared definition/rationale custody: exact complete candidate and reference scope, final exclusion-bound checks, staged publication, durable unresolved effects before writes and confirmed readback. Interruption blocks coherent affected access until actual membership/content are reconciled; no assumed rollback or blind retry.

Use the owning documentary association with exact definition-content/profile identity, resolvable rationale locator, captured rationale identity, five recorded reasoning fields and actor-supplied applicability basis. Finalize definition bytes with their locator before computing the association; observe combined state outside hashed content to avoid recursive identity. Missing or stale associations remain explicit.

failure_behavior.condition: Required reasoning details or the association basis are missing.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the missing or unresolved scope without inventing rationale or a confirmed current association.

failure_behavior.condition: The state changes, authority is inapplicable, or retention/access cannot be confirmed.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the mismatch or known failure and partial effects without claiming complete accessible reasoning.

operations.name: retrieve_rationale
operations.purpose: Retrieve the reasoning associated with a selected definition without inventing current applicability.
inputs: Selected definition and model state.
Recorded current decision associations and requested reasoning scope.
outputs: Available recorded decision details, association basis, subject/state, and separate availability, completeness, and applicability outcomes.
behavior: Follow recorded associations for the selected definition, retaining the state to which each basis refers.
Return an explicit missing or unresolved result where reasoning or applicability cannot be established.
Do not replace current reasoning with unrelated historical material or infer that no reasoning is needed from an empty retrieval.

Use the owning documentary association with exact definition-content/profile identity, resolvable rationale locator, captured rationale identity, five recorded reasoning fields and actor-supplied applicability basis. Finalize definition bytes with their locator before computing the association; observe combined state outside hashed content to avoid recursive identity. Missing or stale associations remain explicit.

failure_behavior.condition: An association is missing, refers to another state without an applicable basis, or cannot be interpreted.
failure_behavior.outcome: Expose the association/applicability gap without relabeling the reasoning as current.

failure_behavior.condition: Reasoning is unavailable, incomplete, unsupported, or fails to load.
failure_behavior.outcome: Preserve the specific reasoning outcome separately from definition completeness.

operations.name: capture_model_selection
operations.purpose: Supply immutable content-bound model input for engineering reading, including customer view generation, relationship traversal, conformance and migration preparation.
inputs: Selected immutable project state/export, or a selected current-state reference which the provider binds to a coherent immutable read state, with profile identifier and explicit member/supporting-content scope.
preconditions: Capture requires an established immutable source basis. For current-state traversal, conformance or migration preparation the provider establishes a consistent read snapshot or holds model-wide read exclusion while binding the complete membership and bytes; an ordinary mutable checkout without such consistency is not admitted. Existing browser callers continue to require their declared immutable input selection.
outputs: Captured members and digests, source selection identity, included rationale and separate optional-content gaps.
behavior: Capture declared model content without model edits, operational-history export or unrelated workspace traversal.
Bind membership, bytes and profile to the selected immutable basis and reject unestablished coherence.

For traversal, enumerate the complete profile-declared entity and relationship membership of the selected model, not only starts or outbound-reachable files. Bind membership completeness as well as per-member bytes; partial access cannot establish absence of incoming edges.

A coherent current-state read is an ephemeral read basis of the requested current model, not a retained Baseline or an implicit switch to another revision. Preserve partial observations only when they can still be attributed to that exact basis.

For conformance and migration preparation, enumerate complete required membership and capture attributable raw bytes even for malformed members; validity is assessed by MOD-003 after acquisition. Missing access or coherence remains a capture gap. Capture does not call interpreted retrieval or require successful model validation.

failure_behavior.condition: The selected basis changes, a required member cannot be obtained, or paths escape the permitted scope.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the exact gap and withhold coherent capture; do not silently substitute another state.

operations.name: retain_relationship_change
operations.purpose: Retain an explicitly authorized relationship change with complete candidate checking and state-bound outcomes.
inputs: Selected model, expected base state and declared profile; explicit create, replace or remove intent and original fact when applicable.
Complete resulting candidate scope and exact write set, including affected definitions and authoritative containment membership, plus candidate content identity.
Applicable authority/disposition for the relationship edit; semantic reparenting requires explicit derivation reconsideration rather than rename authority.
preconditions: The request is within applicable authority; storage does not grant engineering approval.
outputs: Confirmed resulting state and exact retained relationship effects, or invalid, unsupported, stale-state, failed or incomplete outcome with known effects and unresolved scope.
behavior: Bind the exact affected definitions, containment changes, base state, profile and candidate content to one requested relationship change; do not retain an independently authored inverse.
Before acceptance, obtain complete applicable IF-002 identity and relationship findings for the actual resulting candidate and enforce the expected base at publication.
Reject or re-evaluate a changed base, candidate or profile without silently overwriting intervening work; report invalid or unsupported candidates without a successful save.
Confirm acceptance only when all requested effects are established and identify the resulting state; replacement/removal must no longer expose the old fact as current.
After interruption or uncertain partial effects, report known changed and unresolved scope without confirmed acceptance, automatic retry, assumed rollback or mixing states.
Preserve previous selected-state meaning and provide content-bound resulting-state read references for endpoint derivation; retention does not renew approval or evidence applicability.
Use IF-002 check_candidate_identities and check_candidate_relationships on the exact resulting candidate. Preliminary author checks cannot replace the final storage-owned acceptance check.

Hold model write exclusion across the final expected-base comparison, checking and publication; stage the complete candidate separately. Coherent reads use the matching storage exclusion/snapshot boundary, so they cannot label an in-progress multi-member write as a complete model state.

If publication is interrupted, mark the affected state unresolved and withhold coherent reads of that scope until inspected and reconciled. The design does not promise multi-file rollback or exactly-once retry.

Before authoritative publication, persist an unresolved-write marker binding base, candidate and write scope. Preserve it across restart until exact effects are reconciled; withhold coherent affected-model reads and further writes while unresolved. External changes that defeat custody must produce conflict or incomplete coherence, never a confirmed state.

failure_behavior.condition: Base, profile, candidate or authority changes before acceptance.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the mismatch and affected scope; require a newly justified request rather than replaying stale checks.

failure_behavior.condition: A write or confirmation is interrupted or effects are uncertain.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report known retained effects and unresolved membership; withhold accepted completion and complete affected-state reads until reconciliation.

operations.name: retain_baseline_content
operations.purpose: Retain an exact immutable baseline bundle and confirm actual custody.
inputs: Project/baseline and request identities, exact immutable source manifest/content, original profile/rules and included provenance/material.
Selected retention policy, authority and complete coherence support, with external-only references distinguished.
preconditions: The selected project, exact subject and requested scope are identifiable; missing required support is an explicit gap, not an assumed favorable result.
outputs: Exact sealed bundle and manifest identity with confirmed durable custody, or partial/unsupported/failed/unconfirmed effects.
behavior: Apply MOD-017 state-control.md immutable custody; stage complete selected bytes separately from mutable current definitions, verify integrity and durably publish without replacing another baseline binding.
Preserve included original rules and supplied material; do not fetch external references, adopt current state or establish a baseline catalog entry.
Read back sealed membership before confirming; reconcile request-bound effects after lost receipt and preserve sealed-but-unregistered content.

failure_behavior.condition: Required material, scope integrity, supported member kind, authority or durability is unestablished.
failure_behavior.outcome: Withhold complete confirmation and expose affected scope without silent substitution.

failure_behavior.condition: Publication or response is interrupted.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report known and uncertain effects; preserve sealed originals and do not blindly replay or claim rollback.

operations.name: read_baseline_content
operations.purpose: Read exact sealed retained engineering content.
inputs: Exact baseline/bundle identity and requested member scope.
preconditions: The selected project, exact subject and requested scope are identifiable; missing required support is an explicit gap, not an assumed favorable result.
outputs: Original immutable manifest/content and selected rules, with complete, partial, corrupt, unsupported or unavailable scope.
behavior: Verify exact manifest membership and content integrity before declaring complete access.
Return original bytes and provenance; newer definitions or rules cannot substitute for unavailable originals.

failure_behavior.condition: Identity, required member, integrity or access cannot be established.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return precise known/unavailable scope; missing data is not absence or a complete interpreted state.

operations.name: recover_baseline_content
operations.purpose: Materialize retained content into a newly owned isolated recovery area.
inputs: Exact sealed baseline manifest/content and requested scope; selected parent for a newly created isolated output.
preconditions: The selected project, exact subject and requested scope are identifiable; missing required support is an explicit gap, not an assumed favorable result.
outputs: Owned output identity, reproduced membership/content and fidelity observations, or partial/failed/uncertain result.
behavior: Apply state-control.md containment and isolated materialization; reject existing/active-work destinations and escaped or aliased paths.
Compare full output manifest, bytes and supported recorded attributes against the retained basis; caller assesses original interpretation and full recovery meaning.
Do not modify retained history or active work; cleanup only owned temporary output.

failure_behavior.condition: Output already exists, source integrity fails, member kinds are unsupported, access fails or materialization is interrupted.
failure_behavior.outcome: Withhold complete recovery, preserve source/active work and disclose actual partial or unavailable scope.

failure_behavior.condition: Receipt is lost.
failure_behavior.outcome: Inspect exact owned output/request before reconciling; do not infer failure or authorize overwrite.

operations.name: remove_retired_model_material
operations.purpose: Apply an exact authorized current-model retirement candidate.
inputs: Expected model state, exact removal/replacement inventory and supported resulting candidate.
Applicable authority, resolved reliance dispositions, required exact original recovery and complete resulting-model check basis.

Accountable executor and established maintenance interval covering all relevant model, operational, external dependency/replacement and authority writers through final checks, effects and reconciliation.
preconditions: The selected project, exact subject and requested scope are identifiable; missing required support is an explicit gap, not an assumed favorable result.
The executor holds the state-control.md cross-custody stability boundary; inability to establish or retain it withholds removal. Model exclusion or a revision recheck alone is insufficient.
outputs: Exact actual current-state effects and resulting state, or invalid/stale/partial/unresolved effect scope.
behavior: Apply state-control.md retirement under model write exclusion and final expected-base/authority checks; delegate resulting candidate checks to IF-002.
Publish required replacements before removing selected current members, with durable unresolved-write metadata before effects.
Never remove retained bundles/history, silently broaden scope or conflate prepared readiness with actual completion.
Preserve incomplete publication and withhold coherent affected reads/further writes until reconciled.

Preserve the maintenance interval through actual effect inspection and outcome retention; loss/interruption blocks further affected work and requires explicit stable-scope reconciliation before release/resumption.

failure_behavior.condition: Expected base, authority, recovery, dependencies or candidate checks no longer support removal.
failure_behavior.outcome: Withhold affected action and require reconciliation without overwriting intervening work.

failure_behavior.condition: Publication is partial or uncertain.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report actual effects and block coherent affected access; no blind retry or assumed rollback.

failure_behavior.condition: Required writer quiescence/exclusion is absent, lost or cannot survive safe interruption handling.
failure_behavior.outcome: Withhold or stop removal, report actual partial/unconfirmed effects and retain blocked-scope recovery information; do not infer completed retirement or safe resumed access.

consistency_rules: Every outcome carries the requested subject and selected state, or explicitly identifies why they could not be established. Identity alone never designates a revision.
A consumer must not merge successful results from different selected states into one complete current account. Changed selections require a new consistent request or an explicit incomplete result.
The storage provider owns the final acceptance check for retained content; preliminary caller checks do not override changed-state or identity conflicts.
Incomplete or indeterminate writes expose known effects. This contract selects no transaction technology and does not promise rollback or exactly-once execution.

MOD-001 README.md owns the current-knowledge realization. Coherent definition, reference and rationale results share one captured state; changed names/paths do not change identity, but changed definition content does not silently renew rationale applicability.
compatibility_rules: Interpret content according to the profile declared by the selected state; unknown profiles or kinds receive explicit unsupported outcomes.
Consumers must preserve state, completeness, ambiguity, and applicability distinctions. A contract change that removes or changes one requires coordinated provider/consumer revision.
This logical contract chooses no transport, encoding, database, or callable runtime API. Operation names identify proposed behavior only.

sources.basis: Derive the storage/authoring/context boundary from SR-001 through SR-005 and FUNC-001/003/004/005/006/007, retaining shared profile interpretation from SR-012. State binding makes the identity and outcome obligations coherent across the proposed Modules.

System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.

Derive selected-state traversal responsibility, admission/completeness outcomes and necessary allocation from existing obligations. Proposed architecture only; no implementation, verification or satisfaction claim.
Derive single-fact relationship editing, candidate admission and retention boundaries from SR-008. Proposed Design only; no runtime implementation or satisfaction claim.

Derive whole-model diagnostics, separate mechanical/review presentation and source-preserving explicit migration candidates through MOD-003. Reuse capture, interpretation and scoped-check ownership; proposed Design only.

Define immutable baseline custody, original-meaning comparison/recovery, attributable transition preparation and dependency-safe retirement. Preserve selective retention and separate action authority, operational maintenance and actual execution; proposed Design only.

Refine existing definition custody, identity-preserving evolution and current-context/rationale presentation through IF-001/002. Preserve requirements and allocations; proposed Design only, without runtime implementation or satisfaction.
